topic: Qualcomm's double-digit Snapdragon price hike takes effect Sept 1 2026 — why 2027 Android flagships, watches and Arm laptops get more expensive
details: Effective 2026-09-01. Announced by CEO Cristiano Amon on the Q3 FY2026 earnings call, 2026-07-29. Covers Snapdragon phone chips, wearables and Windows-on-Arm PC chips. Root cause: AI-driven memory/wafer/packaging input cost surge.
subject: Qualcomm's double-digit Snapdragon price hike takes effect Sept 1 2026 — why 2027 Android flagships, watches and Arm laptops get more expensive
audience: Android buyers and tech-curious viewers who follow phone launches but not chip supply chains
core_value: why a 2027 Android flagship already costs more, and that the chip hike is the small half of it
tone: reporting, plain, no hype; explains a supply-chain story without jargon
footage_constraints: official Qualcomm and Micron footage + mobile source captures, all credited on screen; no generated imagery
